llms.body:
# Red Hat
> Red Hat is an open hybrid cloud technology leader, delivering a consistent, comprehensive foundation for transformative IT and artificial intelligence (AI) applications in the enterprise. As a trusted adviser to the Fortune 500, Red Hat offers cloud, developer, Linux, automation, and application platform technologies, as well as award-winning services.


## Core Products & Platforms
- [Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)](https://www.redhat.com/en/technologies/linux-platforms/enterprise-linux): The world's leading enterprise Linux platform, certified on hundreds of clouds and with thousands of hardware and software vendors.
- [Red Hat OpenShift](https://www.redhat.com/en/technologies/cloud-computing/openshift): An enterprise-ready Kubernetes container platform with full-stack automated operations to manage hybrid cloud, multicloud, and edge deployments.
- [Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform](https://www.redhat.com/en/technologies/management/ansible): An enterprise framework for building and operating IT automation at scale.
- [Red Hat AI Enterprise](https://www.redhat.com/en/products/ai/enterprise): Red Hat AI Enterprise is an integrated AI platform for deploying, managing, and scaling AI inference, agentic AI workflows, and AI-powered applications on any infrastructure.

## Learning and Education
- [AI](https://www.redhat.com/en/topics/ai): Artificial Intelligence in IT and the cloud.
- [Cloud Computing](https://www.redhat.com/en/topics/cloud-computing): Hybrid cloud, multi-cloud, private and public cloud strategies.
- [Edge Computing](https://www.redhat.com/en/topics/edge-computing): Extending enterprise operations to edge locations.
- [DevOps](https://www.redhat.com/en/topics/devops): Cultural shifts and tools to accelerate software delivery.
- [Application Modernization](https://www.redhat.com/en/topics/cloud-native-apps): Transitioning legacy applications to microservices and cloud-native architectures.


## Documentation and Resources
- [Customer Portal](https://access.redhat.com/): Customer support, knowledgebase, and support cases.
- [Red Hat Documentation](https://docs.redhat.com/): Product documentation and learning materials.
- [Red Hat Developer](https://developers.redhat.com/): Tutorials, code samples, and tools for developers.
- [Red Hat Blog](https://www.redhat.com/en/blog): Latest news and technical insights from Red Hat experts.


## Training and Certifications
- [Training and Certification](https://www.redhat.com/en/services/training-and-certification): Access hands-on training to stay ahead of technology trends, and gain the knowledge you need to get certified.
- [All courses and exams](https://www.redhat.com/en/services/training/all-courses-exams): Choose from our hands-on learning offerings to master Red Hat products and stay abreast of emerging technologies.
- [Red Hat Learning Subscription](https://www.redhat.com/en/services/training/learning-subscription): Choose the right tier of Red Hat Learning Subscription to help your team increase productivity, embrace new skills, and boost your training investment.


## For Partners
- [Red Hat Partner Connect](https://connect.redhat.com/en): Red Hat Partner Connect gives partners the resources they need to help customers pursue solutions in AI, virtualization, and other key technology areas.


## Localized Homepages
- [English Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/en): Red Hat's English homepage.
- [French Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/fr): Red Hat's French homepage.
- [German Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/de): Red Hat's German homepage.
- [Italian Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/it): Red Hat's Italian homepage.
- [Japanese Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/ja): Red Hat's Japanese homepage.
- [Korean Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/ko): Red Hat's Korean homepage.
- [Brazilian Portuguese Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/pt-br): Red Hat's Brazilian Portuguese homepage.
- [Spanish Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/es): Red Hat's Spanish homepage.
- [Chinese for China Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/zh-cn): Red Hat's Chinese homepage.
- [Chinese for Taiwan Homepage](https://www.redhat.com/zh-tw): Red Hat's Chinese for Taiwan homepage.


## Testing
- [Red Hat Testing](https://www.redhat.com/en/do-llms-read-txt): Learn more about whether large language models actually read and follow links from the LLMS.txt document

    <script>
    (() => {
        // configure id of style element, css rules, timeout duration, and mbox info
        const id = 'home-hero-styles';
        const rules = '#home-hero {display: none !important; pointer-events: none; !important} #hero-loader {display: block !important;}';
        // adjust timeout to be shorter for internal testing
        const timeout = window.location.hostname.includes("rhdc-internal") ? 1000 : 3500;
        const mboxName = 'hero-mbox';
        const mboxSelector = '#home-hero';

        (function addAndRemoveCSS(id, cssRules, timeout) {
            // create style element, append rules and append element to document head
            const style = document.createElement('style');
            style.id = id;
            style.innerHTML = cssRules;
            document.head.appendChild(style);

            // define callback functions for Target mbox success and error
            window._rhTarget = window._rhTarget || {};
            window._rhTarget.mboxes = window._rhTarget.mboxes || {};
            window._rhTarget.mboxes[mboxName] = {
                success: function () {
                    // when Target returns mbox code, trigger event to unhide hero
                    performance.mark('mbox success event');
                    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove-' + id));
                },
                error: function () {
                    // if mbox call errors, trigger event to unhide hero
                    performance.mark('mbox error event');
                    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove-' + id));
                }
            };

            // set up function to remove the style element
            const removeStyle = () => {
                const styleElement = document.getElementById(id);
                if (styleElement) {
                    document.head.removeChild(styleElement);
                }
                // cleanup: remove event listener after style is removed
                document.removeEventListener('remove-' + id, removeStyle);
                clearTimeout(removeStyles);
            };

            // set timeout to remove the style element after the specified duration 
            performance.mark('set hero timeout');
            
            // set timeout to remove the style element after the specified duration
            let removeStyles = setTimeout(() => {
                removeStyle();
                // Timeout invokes removeStyle directly (unlike mbox/consent, which dispatch first).
                // Fire the same custom event so listeners (e.g. campaign hero motion) still run.
                document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove-' + id, { bubbles: true }));
            }, timeout);
            
            // listen for a custom event (fired from Target callback?) to remove element immediately
            document.addEventListener('remove-' + id, removeStyle);
        })(id, rules, timeout);

        // check consent management filter rule
        let consent;
        const runConsentCheck = () => {
            consent = window._satellite?.getVar('Consent Management Filter | [Global]');
            // if consent value is false, remove styles immediately. first page view will always be false, so page will not be hidden.
            console.log('Consent check: ' + consent);
            if (consent === false) {
                return document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove-' + id));
            }
            return consent;
        }
        runConsentCheck();

        // if consent is initially undefined, wait for Page Load Started event to check again
        if (consent === undefined) {
            window.addEventListener('SDI-DLM:Page Load Started', () => {
                runConsentCheck();
            }, {once: true});
        }

        // fire mbox w/ callback config
        window.appEventData = window.appEventData || [];
        window.appEventData.push({
            event: 'Inline Mbox Rendered',
            targetInlineMbox: {
                latest_inline_mbox: {
                    name: mboxName,
                    selector: mboxSelector,
                    successCallback: mboxName,
                    errorCallback: mboxName
                },
            },
            __adobe: {
                target: {
                    'lang': document.documentElement.lang
                }
            }
        });
    })();
</script>
